metaDescription: This page shows all types of assessments that you can create here.

examination.title: Examination
examination.description: A Fixed-time assessment that goes live for a specific schedule, simulating real exam conditions.

mock.title: Mock Assessment
mock.description: A practice assessment always available, with a fixed duration to replicate exam scenarios.

practice.title: Practice Assessment
practice.description: An on-demand assessment with no time limits, allowing students to attempt it anytime.

survey.title: Survey
survey.description: A set of questions for feedback or opinions, with no right or wrong answers.

manualUploadExam.title: Manual Upload Exam
manualUploadExam.description: Students download the question paper, solve offline, and upload answer sheets. Teachers check and assign marks manually.
